extra_vocab.en: very simple, with only the things that are needed
extra_vocab.note: 在商務情境最常用來形容產品、網頁、包裝或辦公室的設計風格簡單、少裝飾；當名詞時指偏好簡單、東西少的人。

example.en: Many young minimalists prefer renting small apartments to owning large homes.
example.zh: 許多年輕的極簡主義者寧願租小公寓，也不想擁有大房子。

example.en: We prefer a minimalist design for our new office website.
example.zh: 我們的新辦公室網站偏好極簡設計。

example.en: The lobby has a minimalist style with white walls and few chairs.
example.zh: 大廳是極簡風格，有白色牆面和少量椅子。

example.en: The manager took a minimalist approach and cut the report to one page.
example.zh: 經理採取極簡的做法，把報告縮減成一頁。

examples.en: The company chose a minimalist logo that looks clean on every screen.
examples.zh: 公司選了一個極簡的標誌，在每種螢幕上都看起來很乾淨。

examples.en: Customers like the minimalist packaging because it is simple and easy to recycle.
examples.zh: 顧客喜歡極簡包裝，因為它簡單又容易回收。

examples.en: Our team wants a minimalist layout with fewer buttons and clear colors.
examples.zh: 我們團隊想要按鈕較少、顏色清楚的極簡版面。

confusable.diff: minimal 是形容詞「最少的、極小的」，說的是數量或程度；minimalist 說的是簡約的風格或這種人。

example.en: Only minimal changes were needed to give the website a minimalist look.
example.zh: 只需要極少的修改，就能讓網站呈現極簡風格。

confusable.diff: minimum 指「最低限度、最小量」；minimalist 指簡約風格或崇尚簡單的人。
confusable.usage: minimum 可當名詞（at a minimum）或形容詞（minimum order）；minimalist 只用來形容風格或指人。

example.en: The minimum order is fifty units, even for minimalist packaging.
example.zh: 即使是極簡包裝，最低訂購量也是五十個。

example.en: The instructions are simple, so new staff can start right away.
example.zh: 說明很簡單，新員工可以立刻上手。

example.en: The firm moved into a modern building near the station.
example.zh: 這家公司搬進車站附近一棟現代化的大樓。

derived.link: minimalist 的詞幹；minim-（最小）+ -al，形容詞字尾，像 final、personal

example.en: The new phone has a minimalist look with only one button.
example.zh: 這支新手機外觀極簡，只有一個按鈕。

example.en: As a minimalist, she keeps only a few items on her desk.
example.zh: 身為極簡主義者，她的桌上只放幾樣東西。

extra_vocab.en: the outer line that shows the shape of something
extra_vocab.note: 多益中常出現在產品設計、地圖與報告：指物體外緣的線條，也可比喻事情的大致輪廓。

example.en: The chair's contours fit the shape of the human back.
example.zh: 這張椅子的曲線貼合人體背部的形狀。

example.en: The software contours each image to match the product's edges.
example.zh: 這套軟體會描出每張圖的輪廓，貼合產品的邊緣。

example.en: The seat is contoured to support the driver during long trips.
example.zh: 這個座椅依外形設計，能在長途行駛時支撐駕駛。

example.en: Designers are contouring the handle to make it easier to hold.
example.zh: 設計師正在調整把手的曲線，讓它更容易握住。

example.en: The path follows the contour of the hill along the river.
example.zh: 這條小路沿著河邊山丘的輪廓延伸。

example.en: Contour lines on the map show how high the land rises.
example.zh: 地圖上的等高線顯示土地升高的程度。

example.en: Engineers studied a contour map before choosing the site for the factory.
example.zh: 工程師在選定工廠地點前研究了等高線地圖。

examples.en: The car's smooth contour reduces wind noise at high speed.
examples.zh: 這輛車流暢的外形能降低高速行駛時的風噪。

examples.en: This chart shows the general contour of next year's sales plan.
examples.zh: 這張圖表呈現明年銷售計畫的大致輪廓。

examples.en: We need a pillow that matches the contour of the neck.
examples.zh: 我們需要一款貼合頸部曲線的枕頭。

similar.diff: outline 可指外框線，也常指文件或計畫的大綱；contour 強調外緣的曲線形狀。

example.en: Please send me an outline of the plan before the meeting.
example.zh: 請在會議前把計畫大綱寄給我。

similar.diff: shape 是最常用的「形狀」；contour 專指外緣的線條與曲度。

example.en: The shape of the box makes it hard to stack.
example.zh: 這個箱子的形狀讓它很難堆疊。

confusable.diff: counter 是「櫃檯」，拼法開頭與 contour 的 coun- 相近，但意思完全不同。

example.en: Place the contour map on the counter near the front desk.
example.zh: 請把等高線地圖放在服務台旁的櫃檯上。

confusable.diff: contract 是「合約」，開頭 con- 的發音與重音位置和 contour 相同，容易聽混。

example.en: The contract includes a drawing that shows the contour of the building.
example.zh: 合約附有一張圖，顯示這棟建築物的外形輪廓。

example.en: The road makes a sharp curve near the factory gate.
example.zh: 這條路在工廠大門附近有個急彎。

example.en: Keep the product away from the edge of the table.
example.zh: 請讓產品遠離桌子的邊緣。

example.en: The designer sketched the contour of the new bottle first.
example.zh: 設計師先畫出新瓶子的輪廓。

example.en: The bottle is designed to contour to the shape of your hand.
example.zh: 這個瓶子的設計能貼合你手掌的形狀。

senses.en: the line that shows the outer shape of something

example.en: The contour of the new laptop is thin and smooth.
example.zh: 這台新筆電的外形輪廓又薄又流暢。

senses.en: a line on a map that joins places of the same height
senses.distinguish: 看到 map、height、land 等字，通常是指地圖上的等高線。

example.en: Each contour on this map marks a height of ten meters.
example.zh: 這張地圖上每一條等高線代表十公尺的高度。

senses.en: the main parts of a plan or an idea
senses.distinguish: 後面接 budget、plan、deal 等抽象名詞，且常用複數 contours，表示大致情形。

example.en: The report explains the basic contours of the budget.
example.zh: 這份報告說明預算的基本輪廓。
